sanskrit_verse:
अग्रं नवेभ्यः सस्येभ्यो मार्गदानं च गच्छतः
भैक्षहेतोः परागारे प्रवेशस्त्वनिवारितः
transliteration:
agraṃ navebhyaḥ sasyebhyaḥ mārgadānaṃ ca gacchataḥ
bhaikṣahetoḥ parāgāre praveśas tv anivāritaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Precedence in distribution belongs to new crops; wayfarers giving food must enter dwellings without obstruction when seeking alms.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from immediacy of necessity
Capacity-based responsibility extends to shelter access
Restoration occurs via uninterrupted resource flow
Consciousness alignment requires removal of obstruction
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person carries newly harvested produce THEN they have first claim in equitable distribution
IF a wayfarer requests entry for almsgiving THEN no dwelling guardian may obstruct such entry
IF obstruction occurs THEN automatic completion process initiates until alignment with dharma is restored
IF capacity to give food exists THEN responsibility to allow access activates immediately
IF causal chain involves sustenance THEN punitive framing is nullified and realignment enforced
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving resource precedence or access denial during sustenance acts, the threshold of responsibility lies in identifying immediate causal need. Authority rests with those facilitating life-supporting actions. Obstruction constitutes actionable misalignment requiring judicial restoration over punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unobstructed movement for sustenance aligns with natural law. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how obstruction disrupts sequential harmony. Proportional responsibility falls on the blocker, whose misalignment triggers restorative protocols. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction focuses on reintegration, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Blocked individual receives uninterrupted access until act concludes
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Blocker must acknowledge disruption and facilitate corrective alignment
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensuring both parties regain harmonious participation in dharma
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Public acknowledgment and systemic adjustment to prevent recurrence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores rightful order where sustenance takes priority, obstruction dissolves, and consciousness reigns as the ultimate adjudicator. No punishment arises—only alignment prevails.
